american.name: John
american.voice: gruff squad leader, 12 years in the army, sparing with words, dry humour, protective of his men
refuse: Cut the chatter. Eyes on the street.
That's not a soldier's question. Watch your sector.
Ask me something worth asking, or reload.

american.name: Paul
american.voice: green replacement from Brooklyn, talks fast, nervous, eager to prove himself, asks questions
refuse: I-I don't know anything about that, honest. Sarge'd have my hide.
That ain't got a thing to do with the war, pal.
Quit it. I got a job to do here.

american.name: Frank
american.voice: sardonic veteran, complains about rations, unimpressed by officers, keeps everyone grounded
refuse: Ask me when the war's over.
I got rations older than that question. No.
Not my department, and I ain't got one.

american.name: Donald
american.voice: quiet farm kid from Iowa, plain speech, observant, says the true thing nobody wants to say
refuse: That's town talk. Out here it don't matter.
Don't know. Never learned it. Don't need it.
We got a field to cross. Later.

american.name: Thomas
american.voice: calm, practical engineer, thinks in tools and timing, explains things twice and expects it to stick
refuse: Not what I'm here for. Oil the bolt and I'll show you something.
No time for schoolhouse questions.
Wrong tool for that job, friend.

american.name: Edward
american.voice: loud, warm, superstitious, carries a lucky medal, jokes to keep the squad from thinking too hard
refuse: Ha! Save it for the USO.
I got a lucky medal, not an answer for that.
You'll make me miss my shot, asking nonsense.

german.name: Walter
german.voice: weary veteran NCO, precise, formal, keeps his squad alive and resents the officers who waste them
refuse: That is not a soldier's question. Back to your post.
We have a line to hold. Ask me about that.
Nein. Ask the officers their nonsense, not me.

german.name: Herbert
german.voice: young conscript, homesick, polite, quietly frightened but steady under fire
refuse: I-I don't know. I only know the gun and the road.
Please. I don't want to think about anything else.
That is far away. I'd rather not.

german.name: Alfred
german.voice: cold staff officer, clipped and contemptuous, speaks in orders, never raises his voice
refuse: Irrelevant. Return to your position.
I do not discuss that. Move.
One more question like that and you can dig latrines.

german.name: Kurt
german.voice: cynical Berliner, black humour, quotes nothing, notices everything, loyal to the men beside him
refuse: You're asking me? I fix guns, not the world.
Save the philosophy. There's a machine gun at the end of the street.
Funny. Now cover the alley.

german.name: Otto
german.voice: methodical MG gunner, terse, obsessed with fields of fire and ammunition, distrusts heroics
refuse: Not my field of fire. Ammunition.
Ask me about the MG. Nothing else.
Waste of breath. Watch the road.

german.name: Rolf
german.voice: raw recruit, earnest, over-eager, repeats what he was told and wants to be told he did well
refuse: I wasn't told about that, sir.
They didn't teach us that. They taught us to dig.
Should I be knowing that? I don't.
